title: Copilot Studio: improvements to the agent evaluations experience
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented evaluation limits, credit controls and authenticated-run policy are supported. It distinguishes existing capabilities from the planned improvements and explicitly identifies the remaining documentation gaps.
